200.description:
Entity detail (POST /BusinessSearch/BusinessInformation, fromSearch=false): business name, control number, business type, status, business purpose, principal office address, date of formation / registration, jurisdiction (the site labels it 'Jurisdiction' for foreign entities and 'State of Formation' for domestic ones), last annual registration year, registered agent (name, physical address, county) and the officer grid (name, title, business address). Any other labelled value the page shows (e.g. 'Dissolved Date') is kept verbatim under additional_details. The site's placeholder 'NONE' is reported as null. An unknown business_id renders the site's blank template and is reported as not_found.

200.description:
Filing history of one entity (POST /BusinessSearch/BusinessFilings for page 1, the /BusinessSearch/BusinessFiling pager for later pages), 25 filings per page, oldest first as the site orders them: display filing number, filing date and time, effective date, filing type (e.g. Business Formation, Annual Registration (2020), Survivor) and whether the site offers a document link. The documents themselves (FilingDocuments / DownloadFile) are gated behind the site's search session and are not retrieved. An unknown business_id is reported as not_found (the site renders an empty grid for it, so an empty page 1 is re-checked against the entity record).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `filings` as the primary payload key.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `effective_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD; null when the site shows none (most older filings). |
| `filed_at` | string | 'Filing Date Time' as a local (US Eastern, unzoned) YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS; null when blank. |
| `filing_no` | string | The site's unpadded filing key from the document link (e.g. 769727); null when the row has no link. |
| `filing_number` | string | Filing number as displayed (zero-padded, e.g. 00769727). |
| `filing_type` | string |  |
| `has_document_link` | boolean | True when the site renders the filing type as a document link (the documents themselves are session-gated and not retrieved). |

200.description:
Search the Georgia business registry (POST /BusinessSearch) by business name, control number, registered agent name, officer (principal) name or designated agent name, with the site's Contains / StartsWith / ExactMatch criteria. Returns the results grid as displayed: business name, control number, business type, principal office address, registered or designated agent name, status, and the site's internal numeric business_id that `get_business`, `get_filing_history` and `get_name_history` take. A former name that matches the query is listed as its own row carrying the entity's business_id and control number with null business_type, address, agent and status; the current-name row with the same business_id carries them. 25 rows per page. The site's StartsWith is a normalised word match rather than a strict prefix (`Delta` also finds `Bold Delta Kappa Foundation`); Contains is the broadest. Page 1 carries the true totals; on later pages the site's pager is unreliable for a stateless request, so total_pages and total_records are null there and the continuation is derived from a full 25-row page. A search with no match is a valid empty result (the site's 'No data found.'), not an error. Broad searches (a common agent name) can take 30 s or more upstream.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_name` | string | 'Registered / Designated Agent Name' column; null when blank or 'NONE'. |
| `business_id` | string | The site's internal numeric id (from navigateToBusinessInfo), the key for get_business, get_filing_history and get_name_history. |
| `business_name` | string |  |
| `business_type` | string | Entity class as displayed (e.g. Domestic Limited Liability Company, Foreign Profit Corporation, Name Reservation); null on a former-name row (the site lists a matched former name as its own row with the entity's business_id and control_number but no type, address, agent or status; the current-name row of the same business_id carries them). |
| `control_number` | string | Public Georgia control number as displayed (alphanumeric, e.g. H853425, 0453350, 21282188); null for rows without one (name reservations). |
| `principal_office_address` | string | One-line address as displayed; null when the cell is blank, a bare ',' (former-name rows) or the site shows 'NONE' (name reservations). |
| `status` | string | Status as displayed (e.g. Active/Compliance, Active/Noncompliance, Dissolved, Admin. Dissolved, Terminated, Withdrawn, Expired for a name reservation); free text. Null only on a former-name row (business_type null too). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Search Georgia state trademark and service mark registrations (POST /TrademarksSearch) by mark name (Contains / StartsWith / ExactMatch), registrant name, registration number and class of goods (1-52) or services (1-8). Returns the results grid: mark name, registration number (e.g. S-9878, T-10224), mark type (Trademark / Service Mark), class, registrant name, status and the site's internal mark_id. 25 rows per page; the pager is reliable on every page. The mark detail page is session-gated upstream and not retrieved. No match is a valid empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | Class code as displayed (goods 1-52 or services 1-8). |
| `mark_id` | string | The site's internal id (navigateToTMInfo). |
| `mark_name` | string | As displayed, including the site's quotation marks. |
| `mark_type` | string |  |
| `registrant_name` | string |  |
| `registration_number` | string |  |
| `status` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
